description: Generate 20 realistic user profile fixtures in JSON format. Create file '/home/ga/workspace/test_fixtures/users_fixture.json' containing a JSON array of 20 user objects with the following requirements: (1) User IDs must be sequential from 1001 to 1020 (all unique), (2) Each user must have a unique email in format 'firstname.lastname@example.com', (3) Use at least 15 different first names across the 20 users, (4) All ages must be between 18 and 65 (inclusive), (5) Membership tiers should be distributed approximately as: 8 bronze, 7 silver, 5 gold (±1 tolerance), (6) Use at least 4 different cities from: New York, London, Tokyo, Berlin, Toronto, Sydney, (7) Registration dates should span at least 6 different months across 2023-2024, (8) All account balances must be between $0 and $500. A template file 'template_user.json' is provided in the workspace with the structure to follow. Each user object must have fields: userId, profile (with firstName, lastName, email, age), membership (with tier, registeredDate), location (with city, country), and accountBalance.
